memory_candidates.content: When trimming an eagerly-loaded rule file to restore an eager-context budget, extract the relocated section by byte range (e.g. `tail -c +N`) rather than retyping it into the new lazy companion file, and verify the retained head is byte-identical via `head -c N | diff`. This guarantees zero wording drift and makes the relocation trivially reviewable, following the existing rules/git-workflow.md -> context/standards/git-workflow-narrative.md and rules/state-management.md -> context/reference/state-management-schema.md precedent pattern.

A source-store edit to agent-system/extensions/core/** (rules, context/standards, index-entries.json) that does not touch an orchestrator-critical path (see context/reference/orchestrator-critical-paths.json) will NOT trigger an automated redeploy under /orchestrate -- only Stage MT-3 step 7 (critical-path evidence-gated) and the postflight completion-deploy gate's two call sites (single-task /implement completion) are sanctioned automated deploy-headless.sh callers, and the postflight gate explicitly defers rather than redeploying under /orchestrate. This means verify-deploy.sh Gate 5 (manifest-driven content-hash equality) and doc-lint will show the source store diverging from the stale .claude/ deploy tree immediately after such an edit, until the next interactive <leader>al reload or a future critical-path-touching task. This is expected, not a defect in the just-completed work.

When capturing a test/build command's real exit code for an acceptance gate, never pipe the live command through `tail -N` or `head -N` -- both mask the upstream command's exit status unless the shell has `pipefail` set, which is not guaranteed in every invocation context. Redirect stdout/stderr to a file with `> file 2>&1`, capture `$?` immediately afterward on its own line, and only then `tail`/read the saved file for a bounded preview. Discovered when a piped re-run of test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh reported a misleading exit code 0 despite '1 failed' appearing in its own summary line.
